comments.quote: 房東夫妻二人自己打理的家庭民宿，庭院的綠化種植的很好，據介紹庭院裏有顆喬木是他們40年前結婚時栽種下的，幸福的一家子。關於吃的方面這邊酒店靠近筏頭鎮，如果想外出覓食，去筏頭鎮比去莫干山鎮方便的多，且不堵車
comments.author: Guest User
comments.quoteEn: A family guesthouse run by the couple themselves. The planting in the courtyard is well kept, and they told us one of the trees was put in forty years ago when they married. A happy family. On food, the place is near Fatou town, and if you want to eat out then Fatou is a good deal easier than Moganshan town and there is no traffic.
